plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name limit.
This plan prioritizes de-risking and reducing overall portfolio volatility.
It aims to protect capital by removing high-risk, leveraged positions.
conservative.read: This conservative approach targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating all leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to reduce overall leverage and meet the 15% combined limit.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name limit.
Buy CRCL at 4% as a high-scoring scanner setup to add quality growth.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining some exposure to leveraged assets while reducing overall concentration.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5%/month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of broad market and quality tech exposure.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration limit.
Add to all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to 6% each, leaning into high-beta exposure.
Buy CRCL at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup to further concentrate in strong trends.
This plan aggressively uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups for maximum growth potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth approach targets ~4%/month, stretching for higher returns. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in top scanner setups. Be aware this strategy carries substantially higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the impact of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero to eliminate high-beta exposure.
Add to QQQI to 30% to increase exposure to income-generating assets.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown over growth.
It aims to park cash for yield, focusing on income-oriented ETFs.
income.read: This income approach targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It eliminates all leveraged and high-beta single names, rotating into income-focused ETFs. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
